20261103NV84646.description: Nevada Question 6. Creates a right to abortion until fetal viability.
20261103NV84646.summary: This proposed amendment to Nevada's constitution would create a right to an abortion until fetal viability, or when needed to protect the life or health of the pregnant woman.

20261103NV84647.description: Nevada Question 7. Requires government-issued identification to vote.
20261103NV84647.summary: This proposed amendment to Nevada's constitution would require people to show government-issued photo identification to vote in person, or include the last four digits of a government-issued identification number to vote by mail.
